About this item

  • 1.83" Touch Screen & 100+ Dials: Elevate your style with a smart watch that looks as good as it performs. The vibrant display, available up to 1.83 inches, delivers crisp visuals and smooth responsiveness, with excellent sunlight visibility and adjustable brightness for any setting. Our smart watch has hundreds of customizable watch faces, or upload your own photos to make it truly yours. The lightweight aluminum build and durable 2.5D glass strike the perfect balance between sleek design and everyday durability. Whether you’re in the office or at the gym, this is a smart watch that fits your style seamlessly
  • 24/7 Health Monitoring & Smart Reminders: Designed exclusively for women’s daily health care, recording female menstrual periods for better lifestyle adjustments, our T7 smart watch is your wearable wellness guardian that stays by your side around the clock. This smartwatch is fitted with high-precision optical sensors and up to 10 days of battery life, delivering uninterrupted 24-hour monitoring of your heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, and stress levels. The smartwatch automatically tracks your sleep throughout the night, breaks down your sleep into deep, light, awake to help you say goodbye to restless nights and build consistent, healthy sleep routines
  • Bluetooth Call & Smart Notification Center: Stay connected and in control with the T7 smart watch that delivers crystal-clear Bluetooth calling—meaning zero lag and crisp audio, even in noisy environments. Answer or make calls directly from your wrist using the high-definition speaker and microphone. The AI assistant is built right into the smart watch, so you can set reminders, check the weather, and control music hands-free. Real-time notifications for texts, emails, and apps like WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram go straight to your wrist, so you never miss what matters
  • Fitness Tracker & IP67 Water Resistant: The smart watch track over multi-sport modes—from running to yoga and hiking, with accurate measurements of steps, distance, calories burned, and workout duration. High-precision sensors give you the data you need to analyze performance and dial in your training. Built with an IP67 waterproof rating, the smart watch is comfortable for sweat, rain, and handwashing (not for swimming or hot showers). Whether you’re an athlete or just staying active, this is the all-day companion that works as hard as you do
  • Seamless Compatibility & Multi-Functionality: The T7 smart watch compatible with most iOS and Android smartphones, so whether you’re on an iPhone or Android, pairing is quick and reliable. Battery life goes the distance, up to 10 days of regular use on a single charge, with fast charging that gets you back up and running in around 2 hours. Beyond fitness and calls, this smart watch packs in the everyday tools you’ll actually use: stopwatch, timer, remote shutter, check the weather, find phone, calculator, and even track menstrual cycles. Sedentary reminders help you stay moving during long workdays. It’s the kind of smart convenience that simplifies your day, right from your wrist

  • Smart watch keeps connecting and disconnecting repeatedly.

    1. Ensure the watch has sufficient power.

    2. For iPhone: Remove unused paired Bluetooth devices if the list is overcrowded.

    3. Restart Bluetooth or your phone if problems remain.

  • Does phone Bluetooth need to stay enabled while wearing the device?

    1. Steps, sleep, HR, stopwatch, alarm, sedentary alerts: No. Wear watch during exercise, then open app to auto-sync data afterwards.

    2. Call alerts, app notifications, find phone: Yes, keep phone Bluetooth on for real-time connection.

  • Smart watch not charging?

    1. Ensure USB port (PC etc.) supplies power normally.

    2. Clean dirty/rusty contacts; ensure good contact between USB and charger.

    3. If battery is very low, wait 2 min for charge screen.

  • How long can the device record data when your phone is not nearby?

    Without phone nearby, the smart watch records data independently. You don't need to carry your phone when running. To sync later, turn on Bluetooth, open the app, and bring them close for auto-connection. The watch keeps up to 7 days of data.

  • How to sync data?

    1. Open app with Bluetooth on to auto-sync with your smart watch, or pull down to manually sync.

    2. If sync fails, pull down again or force close and reopen the app.

    3. Still failing? Toggle Bluetooth or restart phone.

    • Dr Sandra Curwin
      4 out of 5 stars
      Large, multi-function, need to check HR and spO2 are not 100% accurate
      Reviewed in Canada on June 8, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This watch is a reasonable price, and tells time, date, weather, etc. The face is rather large - wider than my wrist - and the strap is long. Probably owing to the gender-neutral style of the watch. There are numerous choices for the watch face display, but most are truly awful. I wanted it for the oxygen and heart rate measurement. I compared with my pulse oximeter, and the watch overestimates oxygen saturation by 4-5%. Not unexpected, and easy to account for once known. Heart rate seems more accurate. Note that you will need a USB-c adapter to charge the watch, as it only has a (short) USB-a cable. I have no idea how it measures 'sleep' - it told me I sleep over 8.5 hours, when it was actually more like 6.5. Not bad looking if you don't mind the shiny black block appearance. You also have to download the app on your phone, which I'm not sure about - don't like the idea of sending my data to China.

    About this Item

    • 1.83" Touch Screen & 100+ Dials: Elevate your style with a smart watch that looks as good as it performs. The vibrant display, available up to 1.83 inches, delivers crisp visuals and smooth responsiveness, with excellent sunlight visibility and adjustable brightness for any setting. Our smart watch has hundreds of customizable watch faces, or upload your own photos to make it truly yours. The lightweight aluminum build and durable 2.5D glass strike the perfect balance between sleek design and everyday durability. Whether you’re in the office or at the gym, this is a smart watch that fits your style seamlessly
    • 24/7 Health Monitoring & Smart Reminders: Designed exclusively for women’s daily health care, recording female menstrual periods for better lifestyle adjustments, our T7 smart watch is your wearable wellness guardian that stays by your side around the clock. This smartwatch is fitted with high-precision optical sensors and up to 10 days of battery life, delivering uninterrupted 24-hour monitoring of your heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, and stress levels. The smartwatch automatically tracks your sleep throughout the night, breaks down your sleep into deep, light, awake to help you say goodbye to restless nights and build consistent, healthy sleep routines
    • Bluetooth Call & Smart Notification Center: Stay connected and in control with the T7 smart watch that delivers crystal-clear Bluetooth calling—meaning zero lag and crisp audio, even in noisy environments. Answer or make calls directly from your wrist using the high-definition speaker and microphone. The AI assistant is built right into the smart watch, so you can set reminders, check the weather, and control music hands-free. Real-time notifications for texts, emails, and apps like WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram go straight to your wrist, so you never miss what matters
    • Fitness Tracker & IP67 Water Resistant: The smart watch track over multi-sport modes—from running to yoga and hiking, with accurate measurements of steps, distance, calories burned, and workout duration. High-precision sensors give you the data you need to analyze performance and dial in your training. Built with an IP67 waterproof rating, the smart watch is comfortable for sweat, rain, and handwashing (not for swimming or hot showers). Whether you’re an athlete or just staying active, this is the all-day companion that works as hard as you do
    • Seamless Compatibility & Multi-Functionality: The T7 smart watch compatible with most iOS and Android smartphones, so whether you’re on an iPhone or Android, pairing is quick and reliable. Battery life goes the distance, up to 10 days of regular use on a single charge, with fast charging that gets you back up and running in around 2 hours. Beyond fitness and calls, this smart watch packs in the everyday tools you’ll actually use: stopwatch, timer, remote shutter, check the weather, find phone, calculator, and even track menstrual cycles. Sedentary reminders help you stay moving during long workdays. It’s the kind of smart convenience that simplifies your day, right from your wrist

    Product Description

    KIPTUMTEK premium T7 smart watch is designed for daily life, fitness, and work. It features a clear HD touch display, long-lasting battery, and IP67 water resistance, making it perfect for all-day wear and various sports activities. The smart watch supports real-time health monitoring, including heart rate, sleep tracking, step counting, calories burned, and multiple sports modes to help you stay active and healthy. It seamlessly connects with your smartphone to receive call notifications, SMS, and social media alerts directly on your wrist. With a lightweight, comfortable design and a stylish, modern look, this smart watch is suitable for casual, sport, and business occasions. It is compatible with most Android and iOS smartphones, bringing convenience and efficiency to your daily life. Ideal for personal use or as a gift, this smart watch combines practical functions, durable build quality, and an elegant appearance to enhance your everyday lifestyle.
